art_direction: 霜蓝底藕紫双眼，圆润下弧，安静平视。
composition_variation: Keep both pupils aimed forward even though the left eye rests lower and opens slightly less. The right bowl is approximately twelve percent wider, with a generous rounded bottom. Use softly curved upper lids of restrained thickness, merging into the large black pupils. Matching mauve iris bands narrow toward the inner ends; one elongated ivory glint belongs in each pupil. The quiet pastel background must be visibly colored rather than almost white, matching the exact palette below; retain a soft, low-saturation paper color across the entire square. No background gradients or decorations.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Three user-supplied chat images were inspected locally for asymmetric crescent eyes, pale half-lidded bowl eyes and diagonally arranged brush eyes. Prompt text alone was transmitted; no attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. The earlier eyes-only constraint is retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet; matching iris colors, the specified reference-family eye shape and subtle matte texture; exactly two eyes, no eyebrow/mouth/head, no square cuts, jelly rendering or watermark
